title: Unfold a folding music stand's desk without disturbing the ukulele lying in its open case in front of it
instruction: Unfold the music stand's desk: swing out both folded ledges until the side braces are straight, keep the stand upright, then let go.
context: School band, orchestra and choir players set up folding music stands every rehearsal, usually with instruments lying close by. Here a ukulele lies in its open case right under the path the arms would normally take: the desk has to be opened without knocking it. Each half of the desk is a linked frame, and both must be swung out until their diagonal braces straighten while the light stand stays upright.
setup: A black steel folding music stand (K&M 10065 type, 1.55 kg) stands on the floor in front of the arms on its tripod (legs 69 cm across), centred at x 0.58, y 0.00 m, with its desk 48.5 x 24 cm facing the arms, tilted back 20 deg, its 4.2 cm ledge at 0.80 m above the floor. Each half of the desk is a linkage of steel strips on real pivots: a ledge arm hinged at the bottom of the centre spine, a top bar hinged at its top, an outer upright between them, and a diagonal brace in two halves with a knee in the middle. Start: the desk fully folded for carrying, both halves collapsed against the centre spine (ledges up, diagonal braces bent at their knees); the stand's height and tilt are already set and locked. Between the arms and the stand: a side table (wood top 36 x 70 cm, 2.4 cm thick, at 0.625 m, on four 3 cm steel legs), centred at x 0.36, y 0.00 m, its far edge 4 cm short of the stand's centre. On it, at the stand-side edge, the open base of a black ukulele-shaped hardshell case (62 cm long, 24 cm across the lower bout, 19 cm across the upper bout, 11 to 12.4 cm across the neck section, rim 7.5 cm high, blue lining; lid off), long axis along y, centred at x 0.41, y 0.00 m, holding a soprano ukulele (wood, 53 cm long, body 24 x 17 x 6 cm) face up, body end toward -y; case and ukulele 1.35 kg together. Arms parked.
scoring: A half of the desk counts as deployed when its ledge is within 3 deg of its open stop, its outer upright within 3 deg of vertical, and both halves of its diagonal brace within 3 deg of straight. 1.0: both halves deployed; 0.5: one; 0 otherwise. Any credit also needs the stand upright within 3 deg and within 3 cm of its start, on every sample of the last 1 s, every sampled fingertip point at least 8 cm from the sampled points of the open desk outline and the stand tube, and the stand and both ledges still (under 1 mm, under 0.5 deg). Latched 0 if the stand tips more than 10 deg or slides more than 5 cm, or the ukulele case (with the ukulele) moves more than 5 mm or turns more than 3 deg from its settled pose (taken at 2 s), at any time; if the hands cannot be located, no credit.
reset_notes: Fold both halves of the desk back against the spine (diagonal braces bent), leave the height and tilt locked, put the tripod back on its floor marks, and put the side table and the open ukulele case with the ukulele in it back on their marks.
fidelity: Rigid steel strips on hinge joints closed with loop joints, pivots scaled to the published desk size. Braces have no over-centre detent. Pin friction, damping and masses are estimates. The case and the ukulele are one rigid body (the ukulele is fixed in its lining; its strings and parts are visual only). The stand is loose on the floor; the arm bases stand on a short deck.
